SELECT 
    HOST_ID,
    replace(HOST_NAME, ' ', '_') AS HOST_NAME,
    HOST_SINCE,
    IS_SUPERHOST,
    RESPONSE_RATE,
    case 
        WHEN RESPONSE_RATE > 95 then 'Excellent'
        WHEN RESPONSE_RATE > 90 then 'Good'
        WHEN RESPONSE_RATE > 80 then 'Average'
        ELSE 'Poor' 
    END AS RESPONSE_RATE_CATEGORY,
    CREATED_AT
FROM abnb.bronze.bronze_hosts

    WHERE CREATED_AT > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CREATED_AT), '1900-01-01') FROM abnb.silver.silver_hosts)

SELECT 
    LISTING_ID,
    HOST_ID,
    PROPERTY_TYPE,
    ROOM_TYPE,
    CITY,
    COUNTRY,
    ACCOMMODATES,
    BEDROOMS,
    BATHROOMS,
    PRICE_PER_NIGHT,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(PRICE_PER_NIGHT AS INT) < 100 THEN 'LOW'
        WHEN CAST(PRICE_PER_NIGHT AS INT) < 200 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'HIGH'
    END
 as PRICE_CATEGORY,
    CREATED_AT
FROM abnb.bronze.bronze_listings

    WHERE CREATED_AT > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CREATED_AT), '1900-01-01') FROM abnb.silver.silver_listings)

SELECT
    BOOKING_ID,
    LISTING_ID,
    BOOKING_DATE,
    NIGHTS_BOOKED,
    
    ROUND(BOOKING_AMOUNT / NIGHTS_BOOKED, 2)
 AS PER_NIGHT_CHARGES,
    CLEANING_FEE,
    SERVICE_FEE,
    BOOKING_STATUS,
    BOOKING_AMOUNT,
    CREATED_AT
FROM abnb.bronze.bronze_bookings
WHERE BOOKING_STATUS <> 'CANCELLED'


    AND CREATED_AT >= (
        SELECT COALESCE(
            MAX(CREATED_AT),
            '1900-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
        )
        FROM abnb.silver.silver_bookings
    )

SELECT 
    
    silver_bookings.BOOKING_ID AS bookings_BOOKING_ID, silver_bookings.LISTING_ID AS BOOKING_LISTING_ID, BOOKING_DATE, NIGHTS_BOOKED, PER_NIGHT_CHARGES, CLEANING_FEE, SERVICE_FEE, BOOKING_STATUS, BOOKING_AMOUNT, silver_bookings.CREATED_AT AS BOOKING_CREATED_AT
     , 
    
    PROPERTY_TYPE, silver_listings.HOST_ID AS listings_HOST_ID, silver_listings.LISTING_ID AS listings_LISTING_ID, ROOM_TYPE, BEDROOMS, BATHROOMS, CITY, COUNTRY, ACCOMMODATES, PRICE_PER_NIGHT, PRICE_CATEGORY, silver_listings.CREATED_AT AS LISTING_CREATED_AT
     , 
    
    silver_hosts.HOST_ID AS hosts_HOST_ID, HOST_NAME, HOST_SINCE, IS_SUPERHOST, RESPONSE_RATE, RESPONSE_RATE_CATEGORY, silver_hosts.CREATED_AT AS HOST_CREATED_AT
    
    
FROM 
    abnb.silver.silver_bookings AS silver_bookings
    
    LEFT JOIN abnb.silver.silver_listings AS silver_listings ON listings_LISTING_ID = BOOKING_LISTING_ID
    
    LEFT JOIN abnb.silver.silver_hosts AS silver_hosts ON   silver_hosts.HOST_ID =silver_listings.HOST_ID

with __dbt__cte__booking as (


with booking as (
    SELECT 
    bookings_booking_id AS BOOKING_ID,
    BOOKING_DATE,
    BOOKING_STATUS,
    BOOKING_CREATED_AT AS BOOKING_CREATED_AT
    FROM abnb.gold.obt
)SELECT * FROM booking
) select * from __dbt__cte__booking

WITH obt_ids AS (
    SELECT BOOKINGS_BOOKING_ID AS BOOKING_ID
    FROM abnb.gold.obt
),
fact_ids AS (
    SELECT BOOKING_ID
    FROM abnb.gold.fact
)

SELECT
    'MISSING_IN_FACT' AS issue,
    obt_ids.BOOKING_ID
FROM obt_ids
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fact_ids
    WHERE fact_ids.BOOKING_ID = obt_ids.BOOKING_ID
)

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'EXTRA_IN_FACT' AS issue,
    fact_ids.BOOKING_ID
FROM fact_ids
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM obt_ids
    WHERE obt_ids.BOOKING_ID = fact_ids.BOOKING_ID
)

WITH row_counts AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnb.gold.obt) AS obt_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnb.gold.fact) AS fact_count
)

SELECT *
FROM row_counts
WHERE obt_count <> fact_count
